title: Maximum speed on small arc
description: Essential: Correctly applies centripetal force condition with maximum friction to find v = √(2.25gr) = 30 m/s.

title: Maximum speed on large arc
description: Essential: Correctly applies centripetal force condition with maximum friction to find v_m = √(2.25gR) = 45 m/s.

title: Straight section length
description: Important: Uses geometry (Pythagorean theorem) to find straight track length x = √(L² - (R - r)²) = 50√3 m.

title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Important: Applies kinematics (v² = u² + 2as) correctly to find a = (v_m² - v²)/(2x) = 15√3/4 m/s².

title: Arc travel times
description: Important: Calculates time on each curved section using arc length divided by constant speed, with correct central angles (120° and 240°).

title: Straight section time
description: Important: Uses constant acceleration kinematics to find total straight section time as 2(v_m - v)/a.

title: Total lap time
description: Essential: Sums all three time components correctly to obtain t_total = (32π + 24√3)/9 s.

title: Incorrect friction force
description: Pitfall: Uses friction coefficient incorrectly (e.g., μ = 2.25 instead of f_max = 2.25mg) in centripetal force equations.

title: Geometry error
description: Pitfall: Makes mistakes in determining central angles or straight section length from given track geometry.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations and expresses final answers with correct units.
